subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: After live proof is supplied, should persona TTS SecretRefs enter the existing fail-fast activation contract now, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS missing-key policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204?
rationale: Activating previously uncollected persona refs fixes the credential contract but can make an existing missing credential block Gateway startup, and only maintainers can accept or coordinate that upgrade effect.

options.title: Land under current contract
options.body: Require exact-head live proof and removal of the changelog edit, then land while keeping optional missing-key degradation as separate work.

options.title: Coordinate optional degradation
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether missing TTS SecretRefs must degrade locally rather than fail Gateway startup.

recommendation.title: Land under current contract
recommendation.body: Require exact-head live proof and removal of the changelog edit, then land while keeping optional missing-key degradation as separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the shared SecretRef credential surface and runtime activation contract.
